ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يسٓ
enNotes: [1260]- See footnote to 2:1.
tr: Yā sīn

ar: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
en: (2) By the wise[1261] Qur’ān,
enNotes: [1261]- See footnote to 10:1.
tr: Wal-qurʾānil-ḥakīm

ar: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
en: (3) Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,
tr: Innaka laminal-mursalīn

ar: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
en: (4) On a straight path.
tr: ʿAlā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm

ar: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
en: (5) [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
tr: Tanzīlal-ʿazīzir-raḥīm

ar: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
en: (6) That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
tr: Litundhira qawmam mā undhira ābāʾuhum fahum ghāfilūn

ar: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (7) Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
tr: Laqad ḥaqqal-qawlu ʿalā aktharihim fahum lā yuʾminūn

ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
en: (8) Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
tr: Innā jaʿalnā fī aʿnāqihim aghlālan fahiya ilal-adhqāni fahum muqmaḥūn

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
en: (9) And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
tr: Wajaʿalnā mim bayni aydīhim saddaw wamin khalfihim saddan faʾaghshaynāhum fahum lā yubṣirūn

ar: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (10) And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
tr: Wasawāʾun ʿalayhim aʾandhartahum am lam tundhirhum lā yuʾminūn

ar: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ
en: (11) You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
tr: Innamā tundhiru manittabaʿadh-dhikra wakhashiyar-raḥmāna bil-ghayb, fabashshirhu bimaghfiratiw waʾajrin karīm

ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (12) Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
tr: Innā naḥnu nuḥyil-mawtā wanaktubu mā qaddamū waʾāthārahum, wakulla shayʾin aḥṣaynāhu fī imāmim mubīn

ar: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
en: (13) And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
tr: Waḍrib lahum mathalan aṣḥābal-qaryah, idh jāʾahal-mursalūn

ar: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
en: (14) When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
tr: Idh arsalnā ilayhimuthnayni fakadhdhabūhumā faʿazzaznā bithālithin faqālū innā ilaykum mursalūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
en: (15) They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
tr: Qālū mā antum illā basharum mithlunā wamā anzalar-raḥmānu min shayʾin in antum illā takdhibūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
en: (16) They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
tr: Qālū rabbunā yaʿlamu innā ilaykum lamursalūn

ar: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
en: (17) And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
tr: Wamā ʿalaynā illal-balāghul-mubīn

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
en: (18) They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
tr: Qālū innā taṭayyarnā bikum, laʾil lam tantahū lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minnā ʿadhābun alīm

ar: قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ
en: (19) They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it[1262] because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
enNotes: [1262]- Your threat against us.
tr: Qālū ṭāʾirukum maʿakum, aʾin dhukkirtum, bal antum qawmum musrifūn

ar: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
en: (20) And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
tr: Wajāʾa min aqṣal-madīnati rajuluy yasʿā qāla yāqawmittabiʿul-mursalīn

ar: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
en: (21) Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
tr: Ittabiʿū mal lā yasʾalukum ajraw wahum muhtadūn

ar: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (22) And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
tr: Wamā liya lā aʿbudul-ladhī faṭaranī waʾilayhi turjaʿūn

ar: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
en: (23) Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
tr: Aʾattakhidhu min dūnihī ālihatan iy yuridnir-raḥmānu biḍurril lā tughni ʿannī shafāʿatuhum shayʾaw walā yunqidhūn

ar: إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (24) Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
tr: Innī idhal lafī ḍalālim mubīn

ar: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
en: (25) Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
tr: Innī āmantu birabbikum fasmaʿūn

ar: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (26) It was said, "Enter Paradise."[1263] He said, "I wish my people could know
enNotes: [1263]- An abrupt transfer to the Hereafter conveys the meaning that the man met a violent death at the hands of the disbelievers and so was martyred for the cause of Allāh.
tr: Qīladkhulil-jannah, qāla yālayta qawmī yaʿlamūn

ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
en: (27) Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
tr: Bimā ghafara lī rabbī wajaʿalanī minal-mukramīn

ar: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
en: (28) And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
tr: Wamā anzalnā ʿalā qawmihī mim baʿdihī min jundim minas-samāʾi wamā kunnā munzilīn

ar: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
en: (29) It was not but one shout,[1264] and immediately they were extinguished.
enNotes: [1264]- From Gabriel or a blast from the sky.
tr: In kānat illā ṣayḥataw wāḥidatan faʾidhā hum khāmidūn

ar: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: (30) How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
tr: Yāḥasratan ʿalal-ʿibād, mā yaʾtīhim mir rasūlin illā kānū bihī yastahziʾūn

ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
en: (31) Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them[1265] will not return?
enNotes: [1265]- i.e., to those living presently in the world.
tr: Alam yaraw kam ahlaknā qablahum minal-qurūni annahum ilayhim lā yarjiʿūn

ar: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
en: (32) And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
tr: Waʾin kullul lammā jamīʿul ladaynā muḥḍarūn

ar: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
en: (33) And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
tr: Waʾāyatul lahumul-arḍul-maytah, aḥyaynāhā waʾakhrajnā minhā ḥabban faminhu yaʾkulūn

ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَٰبٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
en: (34) And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
tr: Wajaʿalnā fīhā jannātim min nakhīliw waʾaʿnābiw wafajjarnā fīhā minal-ʿuyūn

ar: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
en: (35) That they may eat of His fruit.[1266] And their hands have not produced it,[1267] so will they not be grateful?
enNotes:
[1266]- i.e., that which Allāh has produced for them.
[1267]- An alternative meaning is "And [eat from] what their hands have produced [i.e., planted and harvested]." Both are grammatically correct.
tr: Liyaʾkulū min thamarihī wamā ʿamilathu aydīhim, afalā yashkurūn

ar: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (36) Exalted is He who created all pairs[1268] - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
enNotes: [1268]- Or "all species."
tr: Subḥānal-ladhī khalaqal-azwāja kullahā mimmā tumbitul-arḍu wamin anfusihim wamimmā lā yaʿlamūn

ar: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
en: (37) And a sign for them is the night. We remove[1269] from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
enNotes: [1269]- Literally, "strip" or "peel." Sunlight projected onto the earth is removed from it as the earth turns and night approaches.
tr: Waʾāyatul lahumul-layl, naslakhu minhun-nahāra faʾidhā hum muẓlimūn

ar: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
en: (38) And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
tr: Wash-shamsu tajrī limustaqarril lahā, dhālika taqdīrul-ʿazīzil-ʿalīm

ar: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
en: (39) And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
tr: Wal-qamara qaddarnāhu manāzila ḥattā ʿāda kal-ʿurjūnil-qadīm

ar: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
en: (40) It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
tr: Lash-shamsu yambaghī lahā an tudrikal-qamara walal-laylu sābiqun-nahār, wakullun fī falakiy yasbaḥūn

ar: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
en: (41) And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers[1270] in a laden ship.
enNotes: [1270]- Usually meaning "descendants" or "offspring," the word "dhurriyyah" is used here to denote forefathers (their being the offspring of Noah), who were saved from the flood.
tr: Waʾāyatul lahum annā ḥamalnā dhurriyyatahum fil-fulkil-mashḥūn

ar: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
en: (42) And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
tr: Wakhalaqnā lahum mim mithlihī mā yarkabūn

ar: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
en: (43) And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
tr: Waʾin nashaʾ nughriqhum falā ṣarīkha lahum walā hum yunqadhūn

ar: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
en: (44) Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
tr: Illā raḥmatam minnā wamatāʿan ilā ḥīn

ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
en: (45) But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you;[1271] perhaps you will receive mercy..."[1272]
enNotes:
[1271]- Of sins or of life in this world and the Hereafter.
[1272]- The conclusion of this sentence is understood to be "...they ignored the warning."
tr: Waʾidhā qīla lahumuttaqū mā bayna aydīkum wamā khalfakum laʿallakum turḥamūn

ar: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
en: (46) And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
tr: Wamā taʾtīhim min āyatim min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ʿanhā muʿriḍīn

ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (47) And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
tr: Waʾidhā qīla lahum anfiqū mimmā razaqakumullāhu qālal-ladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū anuṭʿimu mal law yashāʾullāhu aṭʿamah, in antum illā fī ḍalālim mubīn

ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
en: (48) And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
tr: Wayaqūlūna matā hādhal-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn

ar: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
en: (49) They do not await except one blast[1273] which will seize them while they are disputing.
enNotes: [1273]- Literally, "cry" or "shriek," meaning the first blast of the Horn which will strike dead every living thing on the earth without warning.
tr: Mā yanẓurūna illā ṣayḥataw wāḥidatan taʾkhudhuhum wahum yakhiṣṣimūn

ar: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
en: (50) And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
tr: Falā yastaṭīʿūna tawṣiyataw walā ilā ahlihim yarjiʿūn

ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
en: (51) And the Horn will be blown;[1274] and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
enNotes: [1274]- For the second time, signaling the Resurrection.
tr: Wanufikha fiṣ-ṣūri faʾidhā hum minal-ajdāthi ilā rabbihim yansilūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
en: (52) They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
tr: Qālū yāwaylanā mam baʿathanā mim marqadinā… hādhā mā waʿadar-raḥmānu waṣadaqal-mursalūn

ar: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
en: (53) It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
tr: In kānat illā ṣayḥataw wāḥidatan faʾidhā hum jamīʿul ladaynā muḥḍarūn

ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
en: (54) So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
tr: Fal-yawma lā tuẓlamu nafsun shayʾaw walā tujzawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūn

ar: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَٰكِهُونَ
en: (55) Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
tr: Inna aṣḥābal-jannatil-yawma fī shughulin fākihūn

ar: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
en: (56) They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
tr: Hum waʾazwājuhum fī ẓilālin ʿalal-arāʾiki muttakiʾūn

ar: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
en: (57) For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
tr: Lahum fīhā fākihatuw walahum mā yaddaʿūn

ar: سَلَٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
en: (58) [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
tr: Salām, qawlam mir rabbir raḥīm

ar: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
en: (59) [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.[1275]
enNotes: [1275]- i.e., remove yourself from the ranks of the believers to be distinguished from them.
tr: Wamtāzul-yawma ayyuhal-mujrimūn

ar: أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
en: (60) Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
tr: Alam aʿhad ilaykum yābanī ādama al lā taʿbudush-shayṭān, innahū lakum ʿaduwwum mubīn

ar: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
en: (61) And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
tr: Waʾaniʿbudūnī, hādhā ṣirāṭum mustaqīm

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (62) And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
tr: Walaqad aḍalla minkum jibillan kathīrā, afalam takūnū taʿqilūn

ar: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
en: (63) This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
tr: Hādhihī jahannamul-latī kuntum tūʿadūn

ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
en: (64) [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."[1276]
enNotes: [1276]- Or "because you used to disbelieve."
tr: Iṣlawhal-yawma bimā kuntum takfurūn

ar: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
en: (65) That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
tr: Al-yawma nakhtimu ʿalā afwāhihim watukallimunā aydīhim watashhadu arjuluhum bimā kānū yaksibūn

ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
en: (66) And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?[1277]
enNotes: [1277]- Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) could have left man without means of guidance in the life of this world, although in His mercy He did not.
tr: Walaw nashāʾu laṭamasnā ʿalā aʿyunihim fastabaquṣ-ṣirāṭa faʾannā yubṣirūn

ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
en: (67) And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.[1278]
enNotes: [1278]- He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) could have prevented man from taking any action to benefit himself in this world or the Hereafter, yet He did not.
tr: Walaw nashāʾu lamasakhnāhum ʿalā makānatihim famastaṭāʿū muḍiyyaw walā yarjiʿūn

ar: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
en: (68) And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation;[1279] so will they not understand?
enNotes: [1279]- In his physical and mental capacity.
tr: Waman nuʿammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq, afalā yaʿqilūn

ar: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (69) And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān
tr: Wamā ʿallamnāhush-shiʿra wamā yambaghī lah, in huwa illā dhikruw waqurʾānum mubīn

ar: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (70) To warn whoever is alive[1280] and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.
enNotes: [1280]- In heart and mind, i.e., the believers.
tr: Liyundhira man kāna ḥayyaw wayaḥiqqal-qawlu ʿalal-kāfirīn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
en: (71) Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands[1281] have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
enNotes: [1281]- See footnote to 2:19.
tr: Awalam yaraw annā khalaqnā lahum mimmā ʿamilat aydīnā anʿāman fahum lahā mālikūn

ar: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
en: (72) And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
tr: Wadhallalnāhā lahum faminhā rakūbuhum waminhā yaʾkulūn

ar: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
en: (73) And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
tr: Walahum fīhā manāfiʿu wamashārib, afalā yashkurūn

ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
en: (74) But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
tr: Wattakhadhū min dūnillāhi ālihatal laʿallahum yunṣarūn

ar: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
en: (75) They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.[1282]
enNotes: [1282]- Maintaining and protecting their "gods." Another interpretation is that they (i.e., the gods) will be soldiers set against them in Hellfire.
tr: Lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrahum wahum lahum jundum muḥḍarūn

ar: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
en: (76) So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
tr: Falā yaḥzunka qawluhum, innā naʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿlinūn

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
en: (77) Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once[1283] he is a clear adversary?
enNotes: [1283]- i.e., as soon as he becomes self-sufficient.
tr: Awalam yaral-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min nuṭfatin faʾidhā huwa khaṣīmum mubīn

ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
en: (78) And he presents for Us an example[1284] and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
enNotes: [1284]- Attempting to establish the finality of death.
tr: Waḍaraba lanā mathalaw wanasiya khalqah, qāla may yuḥyil-ʿiẓāma wahiya ramīm

ar: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
en: (79) Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
tr: Qul yuḥyīhal-ladhī anshaʾahā awwala marrah, wahuwa bikulli khalqin ʿalīm

ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
en: (80) [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
tr: Al-ladhī jaʿala lakum minash-shajaril-akhḍari nāran faʾidhā antum minhu tūqidūn

ar: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
en: (81) Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
tr: Awalaysal-ladhī khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa biqādirin ʿalā ay yakhluqa mithlahum, balā wahuwal-khallāqul-ʿalīm

ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
en: (82) His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
tr: Innamā amruhū idhā arāda shayʾā, ay yaqūla lahū kun fayakūn

ar: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
en: (83) So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
tr: Fasubḥānal-ladhī biyadihī malakūtu kulli shayʾiw waʾilayhi turjaʿūn
